subject: Review of Chevalier Theatre Pride Show
overview: Danielle Balocca hosted guest Brittany Balocca on the Medford Bytes podcast to discuss dining in Medford and review the Chevalier Theatre performance of "The Golden Girls: The Laughs Continue."

items.title: Introduction and Local Dining Favorites
items.summary: Brittany Balocca highlighted favorite local eateries, including Goldilocks Bagels and Real Gusto.

items.title: Review of The Golden Girls: The Laughs Continue
items.summary: The hosts reviewed the touring parody show staged at the Chevalier Theatre for Pride Month, praising the performances, attendance, and accessibility of the venue.
